title: Annuaire des statistiques des faits d'état civil au Bénin (2024)
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie
why_not: States no plan, strategy or budget for the system: its facts (2024 statistics for all 77 communes drawn from ANIP's database, 468,570 births registered, UNFPA support for the yearbook itself) fall on events and offices, which carry no gap.
